evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: The 5-year sample retention requirement was implemented in 2009 via CR-2009-012.

evidence.title: Retained sample room full
evidence.claim: In 2022, the 5-year retention was maintained due to quality agreements and a 2009 financial loss.
evidence.quote: Our quality agreements require 5 years, and we lost EUR 95,000 in 2009 (CL-2009-007)

evidence.title: Change request CR-2009-012
evidence.claim: In 2009, retention was increased from 1 to 5 years because a missing sample prevented defending a claim.
evidence.quote: Reason: CL-2009-007 - without the retained sample we could not defend the claim.

evidence.title: Customer quality agreements - summary
evidence.claim: As of 2015, three key customers require retained samples for 5 years.
evidence.quote: Three key customers (two OEMs and one distributor) require retained samples of each delivered lot for 5 years.

evidence.title: Customer claim CL-2009-007
evidence.claim: In 2009, a claim for AF-12 coating failure was settled for EUR 95,000 because the 1-year sample retention was insufficient to prove conformity.
evidence.quote: The retained sample of the lot had been discarded after 1 year, so conformity of the batch could not be demonstrated.

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: The QC release plan QP-02 Rev 5 from 2009 includes the requirement to retain 0.5 L samples for 5 years.
evidence.quote: Retain 0.5 L sample of each batch for 5 years.
